On retry, uniqueGuests filters out emails already in booking.attendees, so if all requested guests were persisted, uniqueGuests.length === 0 and the handler throws BAD_REQUEST 'emails_must_be_unique_valid' — making recovery impossible. Both mechanisms are directly verifiable in the new handler code.
